clearview.options.title: Clear View
clearview.options.fire.tooltip: How far to push the fire down your screen while you burn. Off leaves it where Minecraft puts it.
clearview.options.fire_immune.tooltip: Hide the fire completely when it can't hurt you: with Fire Resistance or in Creative.
clearview.options.shield.tooltip: How far to push a held shield down so it covers less of the screen. Off leaves it where Minecraft puts it.
clearview.options.pumpkin.tooltip: Remove the dark mask you see while wearing a carved pumpkin.
clearview.options.frost.tooltip: Remove the icy edges that creep over the screen while you freeze in powder snow.
clearview.options.air.tooltip: Remove the fog at the edge of your render distance, the haze in rain and the thick fog in the Nether.
clearview.options.lava.tooltip: See through lava instead of an orange wall, with or without Fire Resistance.
clearview.options.water.tooltip: See twice as far underwater, right away, in every biome.
clearview.options.powder_snow.tooltip: See out of powder snow instead of a white wall.
clearview.options.fullbright.tooltip: Light up caves and nights as if everything were fully lit. Your Brightness setting comes back when you switch this off.
clearview.options.keys.tooltip: Set the keys for toggling Fullbright (G) and opening this screen (unbound).
clearview.options.reset.tooltip: Put every Clear View setting back to how it started.
